Verification framework

What every published record needs.

01

Issuer and scope

The organization that issued the record, the legal entity covered, and the facility or product scope.

02

Document identity

A certificate or report number, issue date, expiration date and a readable source file.

03

Claim alignment

Page language that stays within what the evidence actually verifies.
